name: Home Assistant Lights
author: Vinny Carpenter
description: Control Home Assistant lights by room from the Omarchy bar

barWidget.description: Turn rooms and bulbs on or off, set brightness and color temperature, and activate scenes

schema.label: Home Assistant URL
schema.description: Base URL of your Home Assistant instance, including the port. Must be https://, because the access token is sent with every request. Plain http:// is only accepted for 127.0.0.1 or [::1].

schema.label: Token file
schema.description: File containing a Home Assistant long-lived access token. Keep it readable only by you (chmod 600).

schema.label: CA certificate file
schema.description: Optional PEM certificate to verify Home Assistant with, for a self-signed or private-CA certificate. Leave empty to use the system trust store.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to check light state while the panel is closed. It checks every 5 seconds while open.

schema.label: Demo mode
schema.description: Show made-up rooms instead of connecting to Home Assistant. Useful for trying the widget out.
